LESSON: DRAWING AND SKETCHING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: WOODWORK
Strand: Related Drawing
Topic 4.1: Drawing and sketching
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Drawing and sketching, part of Related Drawing in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 WOODWORK.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to draw in Woodwork? 2. How can you make use of drawings in the design process?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. use digital device to identify different types of pictorial drawings (oblique, isometric, perspective), Learners with manipulation difficulties could be provided with adapted digital resources with appropriate accessibility features or be supported by peers, learner support assistant or teacher to manipulate the digital resource,

2. use drawing instruments to make isometric drawings, Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted drawing materials or alternative functional parts of the body or use appropriate assistive devices or be 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use digital device to identify different types of pictorial drawings (oblique, isometric, perspective), Learners with manipulation difficulties could be provided with adapted digital resources with appropriate accessibility features or be supported by peers, learner support assistant or teacher to manipulate the digital resource,
2. use drawing instruments to make isometric drawings, Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted drawing materials or alternative functional parts of the body or use appropriate assistive devices or be 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Drawing and sketching together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: learner develops digital skills when interacting and manipulating digital devices when identifying types

of pictorial drawings.

● Critical thinking and problem solving: learner develops evaluation and decision making skills when using drawing

instruments to make isometric drawings.

● Citizenship: learner develops information and communication skills and global awareness when making freehand sketches

of possible designs for use in production.

Values:
● Responsibility: learner takes care of drawing instruments when drawing.

● Love: learners share drawing instruments and other materials used in drawing
